origin.description: Rows are multiplied by the weights, then residuals are returned on the original scale.
origin.details: Rows are multiplied by the weights, then residuals are returned on the original scale.
origin.value: weights alternating 1 and 2, tau=0.25, on the same design
origin.example:
w <- rep(c(1, 2), length.out = nrow(X))
fit <- rq.wfit(X, y, tau = 0.25, weights = w)
fit$coefficients
